---
title: "Run the Project Environment"
subtitle: "Use one Singularity boundary interactively and from Slurm"
execute:
  eval: false
---

The runner is the only place that chooses a container implementation, selects
the image, sets a clean host environment, and binds writable project state.
The image's `%environment` activates Spack R and the project-local `uvr`
library. Slurm invokes this runner rather than reproducing mount decisions.

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-script-sh file="{{ emit.project_root }}/scripts/kiribati-biomarkers" mode="0755" title="Emit the environment runner"}

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

project_dir=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)
local_env="${project_dir}/containers/runtime/local.env"
if [[ -f "${local_env}" ]]; then
  set -a
  source "${local_env}"
  set +a
fi

runtime=${CONTAINER_RUNTIME:-apptainer}
if ! command -v "${runtime}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  runtime=singularity
fi
command -v "${runtime}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "Neither apptainer nor singularity is available." >&2; exit 127; }

image=${KIRIBATI_BIOMARKERS_IMAGE:-"${project_dir}/artifacts/containers/kiribati-biomarkers.sif"}
test -r "${image}" || {
  echo "Container image not readable: ${image}" >&2
  echo "Build it with the Customize and Build the Runtime procedure or set KIRIBATI_BIOMARKERS_IMAGE." >&2
  exit 1
}

mkdir -p "${project_dir}/.container-home" "${project_dir}/.container-tmp" "${project_dir}/.uvr/library" "${project_dir}/.uvr/cache"
if (( $# == 0 )); then
  set -- /bin/bash -i
fi

exec "${runtime}" exec --cleanenv \
  --bind "${project_dir}:/work" \
  --bind "${project_dir}/.container-tmp:/tmp" \
  --home "${project_dir}/.container-home:/home/rse" \
  "${image}" \
  /bin/bash -lc 'set -e; cd /work; exec "$@"' \
  kiribati-biomarkers "$@"
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-generic file="{{ emit.project_root }}/containers/runtime/local.env.example" title="Emit a local image override example"}

```text
# Copy to containers/runtime/local.env; this file is intentionally untracked.
# KIRIBATI_BIOMARKERS_IMAGE=/absolute/path/kiribati-biomarkers.sif
# CONTAINER_RUNTIME=apptainer
```

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-script-sh file="{{ emit.project_root }}/slurm/launch/launch_container.sbatch" mode="0755" title="Emit the Slurm runner consumer"}

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#SBATCH --job-name=kiribati-biomarkers
#SBATCH --partition=hsph
#SBATCH --cpus-per-task=4
#SBATCH --mem=24G
#SBATCH --time=04:00:00
#SBATCH --output=/n/holylabs/LABS/cgolden_lab/Lab/frontier/works/prospectors/prospectorKiribatiBioMarkers/slurm/launch/logs/launch-%j.out
#SBATCH --error=/n/holylabs/LABS/cgolden_lab/Lab/frontier/works/prospectors/prospectorKiribatiBioMarkers/slurm/launch/logs/launch-%j.err

set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR=/n/holylabs/LABS/cgolden_lab/Lab/frontier/works/prospectors/prospectorKiribatiBioMarkers
mkdir -p "${PROJECT_DIR}/slurm/launch/logs"
cd "${PROJECT_DIR}"
module purge
exec "${PROJECT_DIR}/scripts/kiribati-biomarkers" "$@"
```

:::
